summary: Build standalone Rust wheels from Cargo sources

delivery.outcome: Build standalone Rust component wheels from Cargo sources through production PEP517 backend without Cython/Python payload, reuse produced wheel in Python consumer, independently merge and preserve/release checkout.
nonGoals: Rust algorithm/C ABI/runtime dependency/platform or manifest schema changes; automatic downloads, cross-interpreter coverage, process-wide deduplication.
Source consumer migration, actual NL algorithm replacement, speed guarantee, registry release/deploy or protected-policy/Docs adoption changes.

architecture.decision: Add sorust.rust_backend with native-only configuration using Cargo source, lock/default src/lib.rs and static project metadata; reject Python modules/resources/prebuilt mode, setuptools packaging settings, runtime deps/scripts/dynamic metadata and unsafe selected sources. Share existing Cargo execution, source-input list/fingerprint order, setup factory and fresh staging/wheel guard with dual backend. Native Distribution schedules Rust build without extensions, disables Python packaging, emits existing strict Rust-only manifest and py3-none-platform wheel. Automatically include selected Rust sources/headers/build script in sdist. No native loading during build; Rust required only in producer. Preserve existing dual/prebuilt defaults. Test real source sdist->wheel with Cython import blocked, installed metadata/C ABI, compiled Python consumer with Cargo/rustc failure stubs, actual fresh Cython-absent producer canary. Keep canonicalv22 and independent delivery.
dataChanges: Existing sorust.rust-component/v1 output with producer source fingerprint; no schema change.
interfaceChanges: PEP517 sorust.rust_backend entry point/native-only config profile
architecture.rollback: Protected reviewed revert; existing dual/prebuilt backend remains supported. Preserve source inputs, prior dist, receipts and all ignored checkout data.

validation.evidence: Strict source profile, shared fingerprint stability, source inclusion/custom build script, real generic wheel without Cython imports, metadata/C ABI and Python-consumer reuse with Rust blocked.
Full regression suites, actual Cython-absent fresh source producer, produced wheel/manifest/consumer integrity and final artifacts; indexed canonicalv22/pinned Docs check.
Local/remote gates, frozen-head independent approval/merge, postmerge smoke, owner CAS release and preserved exact cleanup.
